{{Quote|The Alliance commander thought he had cut the remote system off via sub-space jamming. Unfortunately, when sector command realized the garrison wasn't transmitting, they dispatched a Star Destroyer to investigate. Syni IV remains under martial law.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Viran Qol]], lecturing [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] at the [[Alliance Officer's Candidate School]]|<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''siege''' took place on [[Syni IV/Legends|Syni IV]].

==The siege==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified Rebel commander (Syni IV)|Rebel commander]] attempted to besiege an [[Imperial garrison (Syni IV)|Imperial garrison]] on [[Syni IV/Legends|Syni IV]].<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] first cut off the remote [[Syni system/Legends|Syni system]] by jamming [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] communications. He then besieged the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] by carefully remaining outside the garrison's weapons range and launching over-the-horizon [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] barrages every time the garrison tried to sally.<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />

While the jamming prevented communications, the absence of contact from the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] led the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Commander|sector command]] to send a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to investigate. As a result, the Rebel forces were slaughtered.<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], at the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Syni IV was still under martial law.<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|A few Sectors Commands have attempted to overtly assault garrisons, or besiege them in remote areas, and they ended in worse than failure&mdash;they were slaughters.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Viran Qol]]|<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />}}
Shortly after the Battle of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Viran Qol]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] used the siege on Syni IV as an object lesson during one of his lectures at the [[Alliance Officer's Candidate School]]. The operation was a prime example of why besieging an Imperial [[IM-455 modular garrison|prefabricated garrison base]] was a strategy that should be avoided, as it usually resulted in failure.<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />
